# Mobile team spaces

## What to build

Bring team spaces to the Expo app with native controls: a **New team space** action in the Create menu, a **Members** section on the space settings sheet (members, pending invites, invite by email, Cancel, owner role change and Remove, Leave), pending-invite rows on the inbox with Join/Decline, and **Leave space** in the inbox space heading menu. Emailed invite links open on the web (there are no universal links); the in-app notice covers signed-in users. Add an iOS screenshot catalog flow for the members screen.

## API this slice calls (already implemented)

All are oRPC procedures in `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts` under `spaces`, schemas in `packages/contracts/src/space-members.ts`:

| Procedure | Input | Output | Who |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spaces.members.list` | `{ spaceId }` | `{ members: [{ userId, name, email, image, role: "owner" \| "member", joinedAt }], invites: [{ id, email, expiresAt, invitedBy: { userId, name } }] }` | member |
| `spaces.invites.create` | `{ spaceId, emails: string[] (1-10) }` | `{ invites: [...] }` (existing members skipped) | member; `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` on limits; `BAD_REQUEST` for private spaces |
| `spaces.invites.cancel` | `{ inviteId }` | `{}` | member |
| `spaces.invites.mine` | — | `[{ id, spaceId, spaceName, invitedByName, expiresAt }]` | signed-in user |
| `spaces.invites.accept` | `{ token }` or `{ inviteId }` | `{ spaceId }` | invitee; `NOT_FOUND` (bad/used/expired), `FORBIDDEN` (email mismatch or unverified email for id path) |
| `spaces.invites.decline` | `{ token }` or `{ inviteId }` | `{}` | invitee |
| `spaces.members.remove` | `{ spaceId, userId }` | `{}` | owner |
| `spaces.members.setRole` | `{ spaceId, userId, role }` | `{}` | owner; `BAD_REQUEST` when demoting the last owner |
| `spaces.leave` | `{ spaceId }` | `{ activeSpaceId }` | member; `BAD_REQUEST` for last owner or private space |

`SpaceSchema` (`packages/contracts/src/domain.ts`) has `kind: "private" | "team"` and the caller's `role`; `spaces.list` lists spaces across all of the caller's organizations. Invite emails link to `<webOrigin>/invite/<token>`. A removed member's next request with that space header gets 401.


## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/mobile/lib/create-chooser.ts` 6-20 (`{ id: "space", label: "New private space", sfSymbol: "square.grid.2x2", materialIcon: "grid_view" }`, `CreateAction`) and `apps/mobile/lib/create-chooser.test.ts`; `apps/mobile/components/inbox-header.tsx` 71-86 (`<MenuView actions={createMenuActions(t, Platform.OS)} ...>`).
- `apps/mobile/app/new-space.tsx` (80 lines) — name modal calling `rpc("spaces/create")` then `selectSpace(space.id)`; add a `kind` route param (`team`) that calls `rpc("spaces/createTeam", { name })` and selects `spaceId`.
- `apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx` 407-443 — `(settings)` formSheet group and `new-space` modal registration.
- `apps/mobile/app/(settings)/space.tsx` (181 lines) and `(settings)/_layout.tsx` 93-101 — space settings sheet; add the Members group for `kind === "team"` (`SettingsGroup`, `SettingsRow` from `apps/mobile/components/settings-group.tsx`).
- `apps/mobile/components/inbox-render-item.tsx` 124-156 — space heading `MenuView` (Settings, destructive Delete space); add `Leave space` for team spaces, confirmed with `Alert.alert` like `apps/mobile/app/index.tsx` 639-646.
- `apps/mobile/lib/inbox-spaces.ts` 155-187 — `selectInboxSpace`, `removeInboxSpace` (fallback selection after removal; mirror for leave using `activeSpaceId`).
- `apps/mobile/lib/api.ts` 193 (`selectSpace`), 841 (`rpc(path, body)`); `apps/mobile/lib/settings-target.ts` 11-26 (`settingsRpc(settingsTarget(spaceId))` for a non-selected space).
- Native building blocks: `@expo/ui` `MenuView` (context menus), native `Alert` (confirmations), `apps/mobile/components/name-dialog.tsx` (text entry), `apps/mobile/components/menu-picker.tsx` (role picker), `apps/mobile/components/native-sheet.tsx` (Android sheet). Use these instead of custom pills/buttons; custom surfaces use tokens via `apps/mobile/lib/appearance`, system chrome via `lib/native` `PlatformColor`.
- Tests: Vitest under `apps/mobile/lib` only (pattern `apps/mobile/lib/ask-card.test.tsx`: jsdom, `vi.mock("react-native", ...)`, `createRoot` + `act`). i18n gate `apps/mobile/lib/i18n.test.ts` 205-219: every `t("...")` id must exist in all 7 locales (`apps/mobile/lib/locales/{zh,zh-TW,ru,de,nl,ja,es}.ts`).
- iOS screenshot catalog: `apps/mobile/e2e/ios-screenshots/catalog.json` + `flows/<id>.yaml` (shape below; runner `packages/testkit/src/cli/ios-app-screenshots.ts`, seed `packages/testkit/src/cli/ios-screenshot-seed.ts`). Do not add feature-specific flags or fake services to the runner or seed; if the seed cannot produce a second member generically, the flow shows the members screen with the owner and a pending invite created by the flow itself.
  ```yaml
  appId: com.rakazo.app
  ---
  - runFlow: { file: ../subflows/sign-in.yaml, env: { RAKAZO_ACTIVE_EMAIL: ${RAKAZO_SCREENSHOT_EMAIL} } }
  - openLink: "rakazo:///account"
  - extendedWaitUntil: { visible: ".*Change password.*", timeout: 15000 }
  - takeScreenshot: 01-account
  ```

## Copy (same minimal strings as web; add each to all 7 locales)

`New team space`, `Members`, `Invite`, `Email addresses`, `Invited`, `Cancel`, `Remove`, `Owner`, `Member`, `Leave space`, `Remove {name}?`, `Leave {space}?`, `Leave`, `Join`, `Decline`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `create-chooser.ts` (+ test), `inbox-header.tsx`, `new-space.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `{ id: "team-space", label: "New team space", sfSymbol: "person.2", materialIcon: "group" }` after `space`; route to `/new-space?kind=team`.

### CREATE `apps/mobile/lib/space-members.ts` (+ test)
- **IMPLEMENT**: pure helpers: parse an email list, decide which actions a viewer has (`canChangeRole`, `canRemove`, `canLeave` from viewer role and target), map server errors to the alert message (use the server `message`).

### UPDATE `(settings)/space.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: Members group (rows: name + email + role; pending invites with `Invited`); `Invite` row opens the name dialog for emails → `spaces.invites.create`; long-press/context menu per row (`MenuView`) with role change (owners), Remove (owners, destructive, Alert confirm), Cancel (invites); `Leave space` destructive row with Alert confirm → `spaces.leave` → select `activeSpaceId` and close the sheet.

### UPDATE inbox (`app/index.tsx`, `inbox-render-item.tsx`, `inbox-spaces.ts`)
- **IMPLEMENT**: fetch `spaces.invites.mine` on focus (`useFocusEffect`); render a row per invite (space name) with native `Join`/`Decline` buttons; Join → accept by `inviteId` → select the space; Leave in the space heading menu for team spaces.

### CREATE `apps/mobile/e2e/ios-screenshots/flows/team-members.yaml` and catalog entry `{ "id": "team-members", "title": "Team space members", "flow": "flows/team-members.yaml" }`
- **IMPLEMENT**: sign in, create a team space through the Create menu, open its settings, invite `invitee@rakazo.test`, `takeScreenshot: 01-team-members`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Create menu offers New team space and creates one.
- [ ] Team space settings show Members with invite, cancel, role change (owners), remove (owners), leave.
- [ ] Inbox shows pending invites with Join/Decline; joining switches to the space.
- [ ] All strings in all 7 locales; native menus, alerts and sheets only.
- [ ] iOS catalog flow added.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm lint
pnpm --filter @rakazo/mobile check
pnpm --filter @rakazo/mobile test
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
